outcome: Prolonged surgery time of cesarean delivery (defined as >90 minutes)
cohort: 31,660 women who underwent cesarean delivery at a single tertiary university-affiliated medical center
finding: Abnormal placentation, previous uterine scar, general anesthesia, and preterm delivery were associated with prolonged cesarean delivery duration, while malpresentation, multiple gestations, and patient request for CD were protective.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was found to be a risk factor for prolonged surgery time during subsequent cesarean deliveries.
